name: Notion Database to Google Sheets Sync

parameters.content:
# Notion Database to Google Sheets Sync
Scheduled sync of a Notion database to Google Sheets with email confirmation.

**Setup:**
1. Set Notion database ID in the Notion node
2. Set Google Sheet ID and sheet name
3. Set email recipient in Gmail node
4. Adjust schedule as needed
